title: Direct LPC Contour and Shoreline Repair
changes: Replaced opaque compound transition fills with authored four-quadrant LPC composition.
Moved ocean shallow/deep base pixels onto the same summer LPC families as their transition art.
Added shallow-water bank ownership for road and farm contacts and restored mixed-water inner-corner continuity.
Made bridge transition topology use its water underlay while preventing bank overlays from covering the bridge structure.
Simplified freshwater and ocean test-world depth bands and preserved shoreline cells from wide route shoulders.
Rebuilt visual certification through the direct-LPC runtime contract with zero owner-fill fallbacks.
Extracted transition drawing into a focused Rust module rather than raising terrain_render.rs limits.
